shot.continuity: one take, camera moving in every segment
shot.framing: vertical, sunlit white sand fills the lower half

subject.character: wide flat stingray half-buried in white sand in shallow water, mic on a stand at his mouth
subject.physicality: the whole disc ripples like a wave head to tail, eyes on top, unbothered; sand puffs up whenever he moves
subject.anti_action: lays scallop shells out in a perfectly straight row at blinding speed, like counting chips, dead serious
subject.consistency: same ray, same patch of sand; the clownfish is the only other animal

props.shells: a row of pale scallop shells used as coins: laid out, counted, scattered by the surge, and one left at the end
props.clownfish: small clownfish that keeps trying to take a shell

environment: sunlit sand flat in knee-deep clear water, bright caustics on the bottom, no reef, no city
lighting: hard midday sun straight down through clear water — the white sand is the brightest surface in frame, moving caustic net over everything, nothing in shadow

audio.pacing: three lines, no gaps, at 0.6-1.8, 1.8-2.4, 2.4-3.2. Every final syllable fully voiced. Nothing spoken after 3.2
audio.lip_sync: the mouth on the underside moves on every syllable, the voice comes from the ray

timeline.a: the sand bursts upward and the ray rises out of it into frame. Silent
timeline.cam: low over the sand, rising with him

timeline.a: spoken calmly, the last syllable finished in full. One wing sweeps a row of shells out of the sand
timeline.cam: pushes in from the shells to his eyes

timeline.a: spoken calmly, no pause. He drops flat, sand puffing out from under the whole disc
timeline.cam: drops with him to sand level

timeline.a: spoken calmly, straight after. The tail taps the sand twice beside the shells
silent from here on. He lays the shells out in a perfectly straight row at blinding speed
timeline.cam: cranes into top-down over the row, turning

timeline.a: a clownfish darts in and tugs at the end shell; the ray lifts one wingtip and it bolts
timeline.cam: follows the fish in and out

timeline.a: a surge rolls through: the whole row of shells slides sideways across the sand
the ray does not move at all while the water drags sand past him in streaks
timeline.cam: pushes in low along the streaming sand to his eyes

timeline.a: the surge passes; he sweeps both wings and gathers every scattered shell back under himself
timeline.cam: orbits low with the sweeping wings

timeline.a: he settles down flat over them and the sand drifts back over his back until only the eyes show
timeline.cam: cranes down to eye level on the sand

timeline.a: the clownfish returns and finds bare sand, nosing where the row used to be
timeline.cam: drifts with the fish across the empty sand

timeline.a: one shell slides out from under the ray's wing and settles in front of the fish. The eyes blink once
timeline.cam: pushes in on the shell landing, then up to the eyes

negative_prompt: speech after 3.3 s, a clipped or swallowed last syllable, the fish speaking, a second ray, pauses between lines, drawn-out delivery, any sign board, any lettering, English text in frame, deep water, dark blue background, underwater city, reef, dim scene, dark foreground, locked-off camera, slow camera move, snap zoom, whip pan, subtitles, watermark, English speech, extra fins
